topic: 被动语态 (Passive Voice) 基础到进阶全景解析
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：被动语态就像是“主角互换”。主语不再是动作的发出者（施动者），而是动作的承受者（受体）。当你不知道动作是谁做的，或者想强调被影响的对象/结果时，被动语态就派上用场啦！
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：核心公式为“be + 动词过去分词 (V-ed/V3)”。口诀：“被动语态 be加过分，时态变化看 be 身；宾变主，主变宾，by 带施动跟后边。”（一般现在时：am/is/are + done；一般过去时：was/were + done；含情态动词：modal + be + done）。
3. 【中小学生易错点】：① 遗漏 be 动词（错写为 The cake eaten by Tom）；② 不及物动词误用被动（happen, disappear, take place 等绝无被动语态）；③ 使役/感官动词主动省 to，被动须还原 to（如 make sb do 变为 be made to do）。
4. 【经典例句】：① Primary: The green apple is eaten by the cute monkey.（这个青苹果被可爱的小猴子吃了。） ② Junior: Our homework must be finished before 9 o'clock.（我们的作业必须在9点前完成。） ③ Senior: It is reported that a futuristic library will be built in our school.（据报道，我们学校将建一座未来感图书馆。）

questions.question: English _____ in many countries around the world as a global language.
questions.explanation: 考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语 English 是动作 speak 的承受者，且表示客观事实，用“is + 过去分词 spoken”。

questions.question: Yesterday, the broken window _____ by Mr. Green after school.
questions.explanation: 考查一般过去时的被动语态。由时间状语 yesterday 可知用过去时，单数主语 window 后接 was fixed。

questions.question: A new modern playground _____ built in our primary school next month.
questions.explanation: 考查一般将来时的被动语态。时间状语 next month 提示将来时，结构为 will be + built。

questions.question: These interesting storybooks _____ be borrowed from the school library.
questions.explanation: 考查含情态动词的被动语态。“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”，故选 can be。

questions.question: Look! The colorful flowers are _____ watered by the young gardener.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时的被动语态。Look! 提示正在发生，结构为 am/is/are being + V-ed。

questions.question: That famous song was _____ sweetly by the school choir last night.
questions.explanation: 考查不规则动词过去分词。sing 的过去分词是 sung，was sung 构成一般过去时的被动。

questions.question: Paper is _____ from wood in large factories.
questions.explanation: 考查固定被动搭配 be made from（由……制成，看不出原材料）。

questions.question: My yellow bike was taken _____ mistake by somebody yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 考查介词搭配。by mistake 为固定短语意为“错误地/无意中”。

questions.question: The computer room _____ cleaned by the students every Friday.
questions.explanation: 考查一般现在时单数主语的被动语态。every Friday 表示常态习惯，room 为单数，用 is cleaned。

questions.question: All the delicious chocolate cakes _____ eaten up before the party ended.
questions.explanation: 考查复数主语的过去时被动。cakes 为复数，根据 ended 可知为过去时，选 were。

questions.question: Traffic laws must _____ carefully by both drivers and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: 考查情态动词 must 后的被动形式：must + be + 过去分词 (followed)。

questions.question: Fresh milk _____ usually kept in the refrigerator to keep it cool.
questions.explanation: 考查不可数名词作主语的被动语态。milk 为不可数名词，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: A lovely birthday present was _____ to Alice by her parents.
questions.explanation: 考查双宾语结构中的被动语态。give sth to sb 变为 sth was given to sb。

questions.question: These old photographs _____ taken twenty years ago in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 考查复数主语与过去时间状语搭配。photographs 为复数，twenty years ago 提示一般过去时，用 were。

questions.question: Plastic bottles should not _____ into the river.
questions.explanation: 考查含情态动词否定句的被动语态：should not + be + 过去分词 (thrown)。

questions.question: Great changes _____ in my hometown over the past ten years.
questions.explanation: 考查不及物动词陷阱。take place（发生）是不及物动词短语，没有被动语态。over the past ten years 用现在完成时主动形式。

questions.question: The suspect was seen _____ into the commercial bank at midnight.
questions.explanation: 考查感官/使役动词被动语态还原 to 的规则。主动结构 see sb do sth 变为被动结构 be seen to do sth。

questions.question: A new high-speed railway line _____ in this region, and it will be completed next spring.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时的被动语态（is being built）。句意为“一条新的高铁线路正在被建设”。

questions.question: By the end of last month, the ancient temple _____ completely restored.
questions.explanation: 考查过去完成时的被动语态。By the end of last month 对应“过去的过去”，结构为 had been + V-ed。

questions.question: He was offered a prestigious scholarship, but it _____ down by him due to personal reasons.
questions.explanation: 考查动词短语的被动语态。turn down（拒绝）在被动句中介词 down 不能省略，结构为 was turned down。

questions.question: The lost toddler was well _____ by the local police officers until her parents arrived.
questions.explanation: 考查成组动词短语被动语态。look after 作为一个整体，变被动时 after 不可遗漏。

questions.question: _____ is widely reported that artificial intelligence will transform secondary education.
questions.explanation: 考查“It + be + 过去分词 + that 从句”固定被动句型。It 作形式主语，that 从句为真正主语。

questions.question: This newly designed cotton jacket _____ easily and sells well in the local market.
questions.explanation: 考查主动形式表被动含义的特殊动词。wash, sell, read, write 等动词与副词 (easily, well) 连用表示主语的内在特性时，用主动表被动。

questions.question: The old bridge is in danger of collapsing and urgently needs _____.
questions.explanation: 考查 need 的被动表达。need to be done 或 need doing 均表被动含义。选项中只有 to be repaired 正确。

questions.question: Having _____ about the change in the exam syllabus, the students immediately revised their plans.
questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词的分词完成被动式。Having been informed 是现在分词完成被动式，表示在主句动作前已被告知。

questions.question: Why wasn't the proposal approved? It should _____ discussed more thoroughly before voting.
questions.explanation: 考查情态动词对过去的虚拟/推测被动形式。“should have been + V-ed”表示“本应该被……（但实际上没有）”。

questions.question: The young scientist whose innovative research _____ with the award was praised by the principal.
questions.explanation: 考查定语从句中的被动语态。从句主语 research 与 honor 之间是被动关系，结合全句过去时态，选 was honored。

questions.question: The patient _____ operated on when the hospital's backup power system suddenly kicked in.
questions.explanation: 考查过去进行时的被动语态。when 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句表示过去某一时刻正在被进行的操作，用 was being operated on。

questions.question: Never before _____ such a magnificent drone light show in our city.

options.A: has such a magnificent drone light show been seen
options.B: such a magnificent drone light show has been seen
options.C: was such a magnificent drone light show seen
options.D: such a magnificent drone light show was seen

questions.explanation: 考查否定词前置引起的倒装+被动语态。Never before 位于句首时需部分倒装，把助动词 has 提到主语前，加上现在完成时被动语态 been seen。

questions.question: The project supervisor insisted that all the official documents _____ before Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 考查虚拟语气中的被动语态。insist（坚持要求）后面的宾语从句谓语动词用“(should) + 动词原形”，被动形式即为 (should) be submitted。
